body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer dispatched, quoted verbatim below. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `os-sales` · session `session_01CxBKycaiUpA1yGx1XyoGqX`, as the restart act of #24586. ⛔ Not a claim.

**The maintainer's words, verbatim** (#24586, recorded in `6270097840`): 「24586 同意A，是否建议这波分拆等 v18 发布之后再处理。」 The restart condition (npm `@objectstack/spec` `latest` ≥ 18.0.0) was read true by triage in `6291735609`. The ruling's restart act: "one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines into its owning lane … Each card starts with a fresh seam measurement taken at that time, in #23050's shape." 

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/services/service-automation` is that lane's), one dispatch per slice.

## Measured (on `origin/main` `123ff6f4e`, 2026-10-22)

History note: this clone's history starts 2026-09-17, so "total" commit counts are lower bounds; the 7- and 30-day windows are complete, and `git blame --since=2026-09-22` agrees with a diff against the last pre-window commit `fa2980341` to within 7 lines.

- **Size and churn:** 13,735 lines (11,536 thirty days ago: +2,199, +19.1%). 10 commits in 7 days, 47 in 30 days. `git blame --since=2026-09-22` attributes 2,842 lines (20.7%) to the last 30 days.
- **Structure:** a 2,545-line module preamble (node-executor, trigger and connector extension-point interfaces, run/log types, signal classes, helpers), then one `AutomationEngine` class (11,190 lines, 226 members). The largest sections:

| section | lines | lines from the last 30 days |
|---|---:|---:|
| module preamble | 2,545 | 450 |
| DAG execution (`executeNode`, `traverseNext`, `runRegion`, `retryExecution`, …) | 1,860 | 267 |
| resume path (`resume`, `loadSuspendedRun*`, `resumeInternal`, `bubbleToParent`) | 1,775 | 54 |
| flow registration + lifecycle (`registerFlow`, packaged-flow sources, `toggleFlow`, `rollbackFlow`) | 1,498 | **996** |
| logging + node-type vocabulary + registration-time validation | 1,456 | 486 |
| suspension settle/cancel/restore/list | 1,293 | 156 |
| class head (fields, constructor, store plumbing) | 985 | 69 |
| Plugin Extension API (executors, triggers, connectors) | 976 | 158 |

- **Shared state a split must pass:** `logger` (87 refs), `store` (33), `flows` (30), `recordLog` (14), the suspension maps (`suspendedRuns`, `cacheOnlySuspensions`, `consumedSuspensions`, …) shared by resume and suspension with the class head; execute and resume both call into DAG execution.
- **What reads it by path:** 4 `scripts/` files (`check-refd-timer-probe.mjs`, `check-startup-registry-verdict.mjs`, `check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`); no ADR anchor file; 15 files under `content/` and `docs/`; 185 test files import or name it.
- **In flight:** none of the 10 open PRs touch the file.

## The ask (from #24586's ruling and #23050's shape)

1. **Split along the existing seams,** one area per PR. Each slice is **move-only**: no logic changes.
2. **Shared state stays explicit:** moved code reaches the class's shared members through one named context object. ⛔ Not a second copy of a helper, ⛔ not a re-derivation.
3. **Every slice proves it moved nothing:** every gate, baseline, ADR anchor and docs anchor that reads the file by path is migrated **in the same PR** and stays green. ⛔ A gate whose target moved must not go silently empty.
4. **Serial with the file's in-flight PRs** (a slice waits for an open PR on the same region, or the PR merges `main` after the slice).
5. ⛔ No new gate.

## Not in this card

Any behaviour change. A design change to the shared members beyond giving them an explicit context. Splitting files in other lanes (#24586 hands those to their own seats).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: "split large file move-only service-automation engine.ts security-plugin.ts auth-manager.ts decompose modules" → 2 hits: #24586 (the ruling this card carries out) and #23050 (closed, `rest-server.ts`). **New.**
